name: Founder-only social account provisioning rehearsal and coordinated-AI lanes
acceptanceCriteria: Only a founder with management access can open the lab and run a rehearsal.
Every platform rehearsal ends at human_required and cannot claim a live or connected account.
The rehearsal makes no social-platform request, collects no credential, accepts no terms, and submits no signup.
Every provider follows one-writer handoffs and remains inside its evidence and approval lane.

verification.blocker: Exact-head repository CI must execute and pass, then the founder must run all five rehearsals and confirm every result terminates at human_required.

rollback: Revert the PR. No external account or credential cleanup is required because the lab performs no external mutation.
